presentation_robustness.label: Presentation sensitivity
presentation_robustness.description: Reuse of 600 public items across three checkpoints; available conditions differ by checkpoint.

order_ensemble.label: Fixed-binding cyclic averaging
order_ensemble.description: Another 600 public items across three checkpoints. Binary orientation agreement follows structurally from the same two physical calls.

numeric_representation.archived: Probabilities, typed values, saved physical concentration, and observed time are retained exactly from parsed source JSON numbers after independent validation.
numeric_representation.new_diagnostics: Derived concentration and panel MAE/variance use exact binary-float-to-Decimal conversion, 50-digit ROUND_HALF_EVEN arithmetic, correctly rounded Decimal.ln, and rounding to 15 decimal places for JSON. Other counts/ratios use integer arithmetic; extrema retain source values.

baseline_repeat.label: Exact input repeat
baseline_repeat.description: A separate execution of the identical input, providing a numerical variation control.

display_reverse.label: Reversed candidate rows
display_reverse.description: Reverse only the displayed rows, preserving answer-token, key, and meaning bindings.

display_rotate.label: Rotated candidate rows
display_rotate.description: Rotate displayed rows by one position, preserving answer-token, key, and meaning bindings.

label_reverse.label: Reassigned answer labels
label_reverse.description: Keep semantic row order but reverse answer-letter bindings. Values are restored to semantic keys; this is not a pure position manipulation.

opaque_keys.label: Opaque displayed keys
opaque_keys.description: Replace displayed keys with slot names while retaining semantic correspondence. The original keys have task-dependent meanings.

instruction_reword.label: Reworded instruction
instruction_reword.description: One fixed alternative instruction. Semantic equivalence is a hypothesis without independent human verification.

definition_reword.label: Reworded definitions
definition_reword.description: Fixed alternative candidate definitions. Semantic equivalence is a hypothesis without independent human verification.

baseline.label: Original single call
baseline.description: Reuse the forward_0 probabilities; this is not an additional execution.

reverse_single.label: Reversed single call
reverse_single.description: A single reverse-oriented presentation; for binary items, reuse forward_1.

cyclic_forward.label: Forward cyclic average
cyclic_forward.description: Equal-weight average of K semantic probability vectors, not an average of logits.

cyclic_reverse.label: Reverse cyclic average
cyclic_reverse.description: Average K reverse-oriented probability vectors. For binary items, these are the same two calls as the forward pool.

dihedral.label: Both-orientation average
dihedral.description: Average the union of physical calls: 2 for binary, 10 for five-choice, and 12 for six-stage items.

featured.title: Same item, different decision
featured.description: Reversing candidate rows changes this saved semantic decision. All eligible items remain available.
featured.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID with different baseline and display-reverse semantic labels, regardless of correctness.

featured.title: More calls can be worse
featured.description: This outcome-selected example changes from a correct single answer to an incorrect cyclic average.
featured.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID for which the original single call is correct and the cyclic average is wrong; an outcome-conditioned illustration.

featured.title: Concentrated labels need context
featured.description: Inspect the full 200-item label distribution and score variance; one item cannot establish collapse.
featured.selection_rule: Lexicographically first 0.5B JSTS item ID. Assess concentration using all 200 items' label counts and score variance, not this example alone.

featured.title: Expected score is not the mode
featured.description: The continuous expected score, most probable stage, and continuous gold score are different quantities.
featured.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID whose baseline expected score differs from its modal stage by at least 0.4. Continuous gold is not rounded.

definitions.probabilities: Candidate-normalized probabilities in panel canonical_keys order, restored to semantic keys; not calibrated correctness probabilities.
definitions.value: Choice: semantic label; Noul: p(true); Score: expectation over stages 0–5. A Score label is the modal stage and differs from value.
definitions.concentration: 1−H(p)/log(K), concentration within the candidate set; not correctness probability or calibrated confidence.
definitions.calls: Physical calls needed for one answer. Derived and physical variants share members; summing displayed calls double-counts shared execution.
definitions.latency_ms: Saved sequential call time; derived time sums its members. Not live performance or batched service response time.
definitions.source: [source_id, one-based JSONL line within the ZIP member]. File hashes are shared in sources.
definitions.mapping: Raw candidate vector's key/token bindings. display_order=null means that field was absent from the original record.
definitions.featured: Explicitly selected illustrations, sometimes outcome-conditioned. They are not random or representative samples; all eligible items are also included.

limitations: Browsing saved evidence performs no new inference, training, or live execution.
Compare only the same study, item, and model; do not infer effects by crossing studies, items, or checkpoints.
Benchmark source text and answer content are omitted. Item IDs and source_question_sha256 identify records.
New item IDs do not establish semantic independence or absence from pretraining.
Rewording equivalence is an AI hypothesis without independent human assessment.
Checkpoints differ in architecture, quantization, and runtime. No speed ranking or causal size claim is made.
